cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my napkin over the plate like you. Dinner finished; honest talk now. Do you want the truth about renewing our lease?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was keeping a fly off. Yes, the truth, but nothing that makes me panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, keep things off the table. I can give you my answer or a peaceful dinner. Which?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That gives me your first sentence. Do you want to hear mine, even if it's different?

reason: Replace detachable Stance phrases with particular copied cues and corrections, making A adapt the exact Drive while B pursues a plausible immediate concern.
